mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to}) AS new_user_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT activity.user_id) FROM ( SELECT user_id FROM transactions WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} AND deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT user_id FROM posts WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} UNION ALL SELECT user_id FROM comments WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} ) activity) AS active_user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} AND deleted_at IS NULL) AS transaction_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (NULLIF(TRIM(buy_reason), '') IS NOT NULL OR target_price IS NOT NULL OR sentiment IS NOT NULL)) AS judgment_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to}) AS post_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to}) AS comment_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM watchlists WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to}) AS watch_count
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT s.symbol, s.name, s.name_ko, COALESCE(w.watcher_count, 0) AS watcher_count, COALESCE(h.holder_count, 0) AS holder_count FROM stocks s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT symbol, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS watcher_count FROM watchlists GROUP BY symbol ) w ON w.symbol = s.symbol LEFT JOIN ( SELECT symbol, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS holder_count FROM holdings WHERE quantity > 0 GROUP BY symbol ) h ON h.symbol = s.symbol WHERE w.watcher_count IS NOT NULL OR h.holder_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY watcher_count DESC, holder_count DESC, s.symbol LIMIT #{limit}
